summary_zh: 前文围绕主品牌（JD）财报解读，引用CFO称下半年营收有望恢复正增长、盈利继续改善。收录帖把话题延伸到投资判断，强调成本控制、营收增长和回购，并给出股价等待超100美元的乐观预期。后续未见回应，有助判断该舆情偏投资看多、依据来自财报表述但传播范围有限。

posts.text:
$JD revenue decline this quarter likely be temporary.

CFO:

"As we headed into the second half of the year, we are confident to return to positive growth on the top line"

"Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, we believe we have reached a clear inflection point."

"Top-line growth is re-accelerating, profitability continues on an upward trajectory."
